title: EliteTable: Self-Improving Program Search for Executable Control Policies
abstract: arXiv:2610.12536v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: EliteTable is a self-improving program-search algorithm guided by large language models (LLMs) that uses a fixed-capacity table of high-scoring solutions to guide new proposals, edits of existing solutions, and remixes of several solutions. Performance was evaluated across six Gymnasium control tasks, each with ten generations and fifty candidate slots per generation. Each task was evaluated across ten independently initialized searches. Candidate-score medians rose between the first and final generations in all six tasks, and selected-winner search-score medians rose in five. In CartPole-v1, the selected winner reached the search-score ceiling in the first generation of all ten searches. All ten paired held-out endpoints improved in four of the six tasks. translated_title: EliteTable：面向可执行控制策略的自我改进程序搜索
translated_abstract: EliteTable 是一种由大语言模型（LLM）引导的自我改进程序搜索算法，它使用一个容量固定的高分方案表来引导新方案的生成、对现有方案的修改以及多个方案的混合重组。性能评估覆盖了六个 Gymnasium 控制任务，每个任务进行十代搜索，每代包含五十个候选槽位，并在十次独立初始化的搜索中分别评估。所有六个任务的候选得分中位数从第一代到末代均有所上升，其中五个任务的入选优胜者搜索得分中位数有所上升。在 CartPole-v1 中，入选优胜者在全部十次搜索的第一代就达到了搜索得分上限。六个任务中有四个的全部十次配对留出端点评估均有所改进。BipedalWalker-v3 和 CarRacing-v3 有所改进但未达到其报告目标。Acrobot-v1 的十次搜索中有六次在留出片段上表现下降，且配对变化的中位数为负。
tldr: EliteTable 是一种由大语言模型引导、利用固定容量精英方案表来指导方案生成与改进的自我改进程序搜索算法，在六个 Gymnasium 控制任务上验证了其迭代提升可执行控制策略性能的能力。
en_tdlr: EliteTable is an LLM-guided self-improving program-search algorithm that uses a fixed-capacity table of elite solutions to guide proposal, editing, and remixing, demonstrating iterative gains in learning executable control policies across six Gymnasium control tasks.
